seed_derivation: first eight bytes big-endian SHA256 of canonical JSON [master_seed, scenario_name, phase, world_index]; reference draws SHA256 [world_seed, 'reference', draw_index]
nominal_test: one-sided upper-tail conditional parametric bootstrap p = (1 + #reference >= observed)/(1 + 99), alpha .05
selection_statistic: max(cross-meeting consensus frequency >=0.875, largest residual correlation eigenvalue fraction, concordant two-source-split correlation)
fitting_search: kmeans and PAM-like medoids, each k in {2,3}, starts {13,29}, two equal weighted families; no post-hoc winner
nuisance_model: observed fitted prevalence/X, meeting, speech, affiliation and AR1 year correlated shocks estimated by pooled source-pair moments; length-conditional bounded Gaussian count emission; nuisance re-estimated in all references
source_group_policy: meeting and source-family/parent closure checked; 12 years, two meetings per year, >=24 meeting groups, >=72 synthetic selected observations, source balance effective Kish groups >=12
failure_policy: fail closed if source/selection/representation hash invalid, any reference nuisance or model fit fails, weak year parameter identification, rho bound, cross-family, insufficient groups, MNAR; do not impute rejected or withheld as nonrejections
outer_world_role: independent synthetic development and independently seeded synthetic holdout; the real reserved October 5-6 meetings remain sealed
holdout_threshold_selection: none; alpha, all searched settings and omission rules frozen before holdout
reported_rates: false positives, known-structure rejections, no-rejection coverage among complete draws with Wilson95 intervals; mandatory attempts and completion fractions; parameter interval coverage explicitly unavailable
scientific_gate_policy: engineering-only; PR57 frozen 1999 references by 1000 worlds unchanged; G01-G13 not passed
